_about: Copy to rebrand.config.json, fill in the new brand values, then: node tools/rebrand.mjs --dry-run → --write. Only colour/text tokens are touched; shortcodes, REST namespace and URL params are never rewritten.
_colorsHint: Map old colour → new colour. Every accent in all four modules is derived from these keys.
_rgbShadowsHint: true = rgba() shadows derived from the navy colour are rewritten too (keep shadows consistent with the new dark colour).

replacements._comment: Default contact number shipped in the plugin.
Brand name inside copy (blog CTA, magazine breadcrumb, item-list schema).
